bannerNotice.body: The revised Standard applied to listed companies (domestic and overseas-listed) from January 1, 2020, and to all other enterprises from January 1, 2021 – a staggered rollout reflecting the scale of the change.

title: Revenue
summary: Revenue is part of the Chinese Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (ASBE).
